## Product: PAA Standard

- **PAA (Private AI-Agent Appliance)**: A new AI hardware product category defined by STRATRONIX.
- **Reference implementation**: STA-100 — 1U rack-mounted, 70B LLM on-premise, zero cloud.
- **Pricing**: ¥1,999 (CNY) / $369 (USD)
- **Standards alignment**: EU AI Act 2026 (Regulation 2024/1689), GDPR, China DSL/PIPL
